company_type: Dream / Super Dream Companies (Tier-1: CTC > 10 LPA)
rule: Minimum CGPA of 7.5 or 8.0 with no history of backlogs (0 active, 0 history). 10th and 12th standard aggregate must be 75% or higher.
guidelines: Students securing Tier-1 offer are out of subsequent placement drives except for Super Dream packages exceeding 20 LPA.

company_type: Core / Product Engineering Companies (Tier-2: CTC 6-10 LPA)
rule: Minimum CGPA of 6.75 or 7.0 with no active backlogs at the time of drive. Past cleared backlogs permitted up to a maximum of 2.
guidelines: Technical coding test qualification is mandatory; aptitude clearance is monitored.

company_type: Mass Recruiters / IT Services (Tier-3: CTC 3.5 - 6.0 LPA)
rule: Minimum CGPA of 6.0 or 60% aggregate across all completed semesters. Maximum of 1 active backlog allowed by select recruiters like TCS, Cognizant, Wipro, Accenture.
guidelines: Students must possess foundational programming skills in Java, Python, or C++ and English communication clearance.

rule: Once a student is placed in a company offering CTC between 3.5 to 6.5 LPA, they are eligible to attempt only for Dream / Super Dream companies offering CTC >= 2X of their current offer.
guidelines: Prevents hoarding of offers and ensures equitable placement opportunities for all batchmates.

rule: Students must achieve 85% attendance in Placement Training Soft-Skills, Quantitative Aptitude, and Mock Technical Coding bootcamps organized by the Career Development Cell.
guidelines: Unexcused absence from 2 consecutive training sessions leads to debarment from 3 upcoming placement drives.

rule: Registration on the CampusIQ Placement Portal is mandatory with verified marks, resume, and undertaking. Misrepresentation of CGPA or backlogs leads to permanent debarment.
guidelines: Dress code is strictly formal western/business attire for all virtual and in-person interviews.

rule: Students selected for 6-month VIII semester industrial internships must maintain regular communication with T&P cell and submit monthly work progress reports.
guidelines: PPO (Pre-Placement Offer) conversions must be formally communicated to college within 7 working days.

rule: If a student registers for a company drive, clears online assessment, and fails to attend subsequent technical/HR interview without medical emergency, they are blacklisted for 2 subsequent recruitment cycles.
guidelines: Respect for corporate recruiters' schedule is strictly enforced.

rule: Minimum CGPA of 6.5, with demonstrated GitHub projects, full-stack applications, open-source contributions, or competitive programming rankings (LeetCode, CodeChef).
guidelines: Practical hands-on coding skills often prioritized over theoretical marks.

rule: Students who cleared supplementary exams must obtain provisional backlog clearance certificates from the Examination Branch and update their CampusIQ placement profile immediately.
guidelines: Companies do not consider backlog results awaiting revaluation as cleared.

company_type: Special Diversity & Women in Tech Hiring Drives
rule: Global tech corporations (Google WE, Amazon WOW, Adobe SheCodes) hold targeted initiatives with CGPA criterion of 7.0+ for female students.
guidelines: Specialized mentorship and coding preparation sessions offered by college alumni.

rule: Students must carry 3 hard copies of verified resume, 4 passport photos, government ID (Aadhaar/PAN), college ID, and original marks memos in a neat portfolio file.
guidelines: Failure to produce documents during physical document verification causes instant rejection.

rule: Students pursuing higher studies or government civil services exams can opt out of placement drives by submitting an undertaking signed by parents before the start of the 7th semester.
guidelines: Exempts students from mandatory placement fee and training bootcamps.

rule: Students securing off-campus offers can request College No-Objection Certificate (NOC) for early onboarding if they have cleared all 7 semesters with no pending subjects.
guidelines: Requires submission of formal company offer letter and parent consent letter.

rule: Major hiring season spans August to March. Major visiting firms include Amazon, ServiceNow, Epam, Virtusa, TCS Digital, Cognizant, Wipro, Capgemini, Hexaware, and Darwinbox.
guidelines: Over 75+ tech and engineering recruiters visit MLRIT campus annually.
